lines.text: At eleven forty seven P.M., every phone in Harlow Point lit up. At the exact same second.
lines.sub: At 11:47 p.m., every phone in Harlow Point lit up… at the exact same second.

lines.text: Same message. No sender. You have twenty four hours. Do not trust the person closest to you.
lines.sub: Same message. No sender. “You have 24 hours. Do not trust the person closest to you.”

lines.text: Nora Vance thought it was a prank. Then her missing father's radio turned itself on.
lines.sub: Nora Vance thought it was a prank. Then her missing father's radio turned itself on.

lines.text: Nora. If you can hear this, it's already started.
lines.sub: “Nora… if you can hear this, it's already started.”

lines.text: The voice knew her name. And it sounded exactly like her.
lines.sub: The voice knew her name. And it sounded exactly like her.

lines.text: Nora! Did you get it too?
Theo. Her best friend since they were six.
lines.sub: Theo. Her best friend since they were six.

lines.text: Her little brother had drawn this room. This moment. And someone standing behind Theo.
lines.sub: Her little brother had drawn this room. This moment. And someone standing behind Theo.

lines.text: Don't trust Theo. He got the message three weeks ago. Come to the tower. Alone.
lines.sub: “Don't trust Theo. He got the message three weeks ago. Come to the tower. Alone.”

lines.text: Then, across town, the lights began to go out.
lines.sub: Then, across town, the lights began to go out.

lines.text: What should Nora do? A. Let Theo explain. B. Go to the tower alone.
lines.sub: What should Nora do? A: Let Theo explain. B: Go to the tower alone.
